Application Data.NAME: John's Furniture Emporium
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: John's Furniture Emporium specializes in retailing high-quality furniture, including sofas, chairs, tables, and storage solutions. The business operates primarily from its physical storefront in Springfield, IL, where a well-organized sales floor showcases a diverse range of products. In addition to retail sales, we offer professional furniture delivery and installation services, accounting for 15% of our total revenue. Our operations adhere to strict safety and quality control protocols, ensuring our team is trained in proper handling and installation techniques to minimize the risk of damage or injury. We maintain comprehensive inventory management practices, conducting regular audits to uphold the integrity of our stock, which is valued between $500,000 and $1 million. We also prioritize sourcing materials responsibly, avoiding the use of exotic or endangered woods. Our focus on customer satisfaction and commitment to quality helps us maintain a strong reputation in the local market.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a delivery incident occurred when an installer accidentally damaged a customer's dining room floor while moving a large table. The estimated cost of repairs was $2,500. The claim was filed promptly and has been settled, with all repairs completed to the customer's satisfaction. The loss was categorized as closed.
